name: v1.2.3 — corrected doi_resolves sub-test + type/tier fixes
body:
Two ground-truth corrections to the released splits.

**1. `doi_resolves` (110 entries)** — dev_public 48, test_public 41, test_crossdomain 21. These recorded a *failed* DOI resolution while carrying no `doi` field at all. The schema reserves `False` for a check that ran and failed, `None` for not-applicable, so they now carry `None`. Entries whose DOI is present and genuinely fails to resolve are unchanged. Three code paths caused it (generators in `tier2.py`, `real_world` annotation, `scrape_crossdomain.py`); all fixed, plus a structural check in `verify_subtests.py`.

**2. type/tier (4 entries)** — real_world entries whose source evidence shows no title or author match, retyped from `placeholder_authors` / `fabricated_doi` / `preprint_as_published` (tiers 1–2) to `plausible_fabrication` (tier 3).

**Impact:** no detection metric changes from (1) — sub-tests feed only `subtest_accuracy_table()`. (2) moves 4 of 1246 hallucinated entries across tiers. Labels and split unchanged from v1.2.2;`tier_distribution` / `type_distribution` in `metadata.json` refreshed.

Also in this release: the data directory was renamed `data/v1.0/` → `data/v1.2/` and updated related paths.

name: v1.2.2 — verified explanations for the raw generation pool
body:
Replaces the 196 remaining stale `[Re-classified]` explanation strings in `data/v1.0/llm_generated.jsonl`, the raw generation pool. The pool is pipeline provenance and feeds no released split, so **every reported benchmark number is unaffected**; all split files are byte-identical to v1.2.1.

- Each replacement was drafted and adversarially verified against CrossRef/arXiv/DBLP records; per-entry evidence in `results/reviewer_experiments/explanation_fixes_v122_pool.json`.
- 58 pool entries whose metadata fully matches a real publication (perturbations that produced a correct citation) are marked `flag_label=true` in the fix log; labels are unchanged.
- `scripts/fix_stale_explanations.py --pool` applies the log; a per-key occurrence index disambiguates the six duplicate `bibtex_key`s in the pool.
- `metadata.json` → 1.2.2 with an `explanation_fix_pool` provenance block; checksum refresh in `croissant.json`/`HOSTING.md`.

name: HALLMARK v1.2.1 — corrected explanation strings
body:
Metadata-only data release: replaces 133 stale explanation strings in `dev_public.jsonl` (77) and `test_public.jsonl` (56) that carried generation-pipeline re-classifier output instead of ground-truth diagnoses — in several cases contradicting the released fields and sub-tests. **Labels, hallucination types, difficulty tiers, sub-tests, and split membership are unchanged from v1.2.0**; exactly 133 lines differ, each only in the `explanation` value.

- 97 HALLUCINATED entries: explanations rewritten and adversarially verified against CrossRef/arXiv/DBLP records; per-entry evidence and the previous strings in `results/reviewer_experiments/explanation_fixes_v121.json`.
- 36 VALID entries: explanation set to the ground-truth audit's `relabel_reason`.
- Reproducible applier: `scripts/fix_stale_explanations.py`.
- `metadata.json` → 1.2.1 with an `explanation_fix` provenance block.

Note: baseline results and paper numbers are unaffected (labels unchanged). The HuggingFace mirror still carries v1.2.0 jsonl/parquet until refreshed. `llm_generated.jsonl` (raw generation pool) intentionally keeps its original pipeline output as provenance.

name: v1.2.0 — matched cross-domain eval + Walters–Wilder supplement results + canonical temporal supplement
body:
Releases the evaluation artifacts backing the HALLMARK paper's arXiv v1 (paper repo tag `arxiv-v1`). Core split contents are byte-identical to v1.1.1 (post-relabel); `data/v1.0/metadata.json` identifies this release (`version: 1.2.0`).

- **Recency-matched cross-domain split** (`data/v1.1_crossdomain_matched/`, 452 entries: 152 canonically-resolved pre-cutoff biomed valid + 300 hallucinated) with the full LLM cohort results, the two-stage cascade, and the domain×recency 2×2 decomposition (`results/crossdomain_llms/`, `results/crossdomain_matched_llms/`).
- **Walters–Wilder ChatGPT-citation supplement results**: four zero-shot LLM verifiers plus the agentic btu-only harness on the 341-entry supplement (`results/walters_wilder_llm/`).
- **Canonical 448-entry temporal supplement** (`results/temporal_supplement/temporal_supplement_448_canonical.jsonl`, 300 valid / 148 hallucinated) — the file all released temporal predictions resolve to.
- **Sonnet 4.6 cutoff-aware vs default temporal/pre-cutoff runs**; force-added btu `test_crossdomain` aggregate metrics; `scripts/compute_pairwise_kappa.py`.
- Repo hygiene: regenerable api_logs/checkpoints ignored; LFS exemption for the one raw-committed supplement file.

name: v1.1.1 — ground-truth relabel + benchmark hardening
body:
Corrective release on top of v1.1.0. **Evaluation results change vs v1.1.0 — re-evaluate against this version.**

## Ground-truth correction
The v1.0 auto-labeller resolved DOIs via CrossRef only, which does not index arXiv DataCite DOIs (`10.48550/arXiv.*`), so it wrongly flagged real papers (OPT, PaLM, Flamingo, LLaMA, PaLM-E, Least-to-Most, …) as HALLUCINATED. A deterministic, multi-source relabeller (`scripts/relabel_ground_truth.py`, supersedes `patch_mislabels.py`) corrects this — flipping to VALID only when an entry is a fully-correct citation on the field its `hallucination_type` marks defective, retyping genuine perturbations, abstaining otherwise (4 adversarial-verification passes).

- 29 flips + ~186 retypes + 32 schema cleanups.
- New counts: **dev 513 valid / 606 hall, test 312 / 519, hidden 210 / 244; total 1,036 valid / 1,490 hall / 2,526.** VALID-with-type inconsistency now 0.

## Headline impact
Correcting the labels inverts the dev ranking among independent tools: **Opus 4.7 now leads F1/MCC (0.830 / 0.683); Sonnet 4.6 best-calibrated (ECE 0.066)** — Sonnet over-flagged 19/27 recovered real papers vs Opus's 8. bibtex-updater's F1 lead over Sonnet reverses on test_public. Rankings otherwise hold.

## Hardening
Pre-screening middle-initial false-positive fixed; bootstrap CIs shipped; results-freshness CI guard; sub-test QA extended to all 6; verbatim canary-emission scanner.

Authoritative old→new mapping: `results/reviewer_experiments/results_manifest.md`. Stress-test brief: `HARDENING_BRIEF.md`.

name: v1.1.0 — Stage-2 diagnosis cascade + cross-domain + temporal expansion
body:
## Highlights

- **DB-first cascade baselines**: `cascade_db_diagnosis` (Stage 1 bibtex-updater + Stage 2 LLM diagnoser) with conservative and aggressive variants. Aggressive lifts Tier-3 F1 by **+11.1 pp on `test_public`** and **+15.3 pp on `dev_public`** at ≤0.1 pp FPR cost — see [README](README.md#headline-cascade-results-v11) for the full table.
- **HalluCiteChecker + CheckIfExist baseline ports** ([Sakai et al. 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.26835), [Abbonato 2026](https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15871)).
- **Cross-domain test split** (bioRxiv + PubMed + CS-non-ML) — benchmark no longer CS-ML-only.
- **Temporal expansion to 2024–2025** + DBLP key fixes + real-world withdrawn-paper incidents (bioRxiv + medRxiv).
- **Dual-mode evaluation**: `--eval-mode {conservative, aggressive, both}` quantifies the abstention/indexing-lag tax.
- **OpenRouter-routed agentic Sonnet 4.6**: `llm_agentic_openrouter_claude_sonnet_4_6` — drop-in for the Anthropic-direct baseline without an Anthropic API key.
- **HTTP-cache reproducibility layer**: `--cache-path` SQLite-backed `requests-cache` wrapper for frozen API responses.
- **Diagnostics**: `--timing-breakdown`, `--subtask-diagnostic`, `predicted_hallucination_type`, `cascade_stage` fields.

## Cascade results

| Split          | Mode         |   DR  |  FPR  |   F1  | Tier-3 F1 | AUROC |
|----------------|--------------|------:|------:|------:|----------:|------:|
| `dev_public`   | conservative | 0.976 | 0.559 | 0.760 |     0.417 | 0.833 |
| `dev_public`   | **aggressive** | 0.983 | 0.560 | 0.815 | **0.570** | 0.740 |
| `test_public`  | conservative | 0.972 | 0.456 | 0.854 |     0.596 | 0.867 |
| `test_public`  | **aggressive** | 0.978 | 0.456 | 0.882 | **0.707** | 0.805 |
| `stress_test`  | conservative | 0.969 |   —   | 0.985 |     0.983 |   —   |
| `stress_test`  | **aggressive** | 0.975 |   —   | 0.987 |     0.986 |   —   |

Stage 2 = Claude Sonnet 4.6 via OpenRouter, up to 5 tool calls per entry. Full per-tier / per-type breakdowns in `data/v1.0/baseline_results/cascade_db_diagnosis*.json`.

## Test coverage

- 905 tests passing, 2 skipped on Python 3.10 / 3.11 / 3.12 / 3.13
- 44 cascade-specific tests (21 unit + 20 type-metrics + 3 integration)
- mypy, ruff, ruff-format clean

## Backward compatibility

- `Prediction` schema additions (`predicted_hallucination_type`, `cascade_stage`) default to `None` — existing JSONL files round-trip cleanly.
- All new CLI flags are additive.
- `EvaluationResult` new fields default to `None`/`{}`.

## Quick start

```bash
hallmark evaluate --split dev_public --baseline cascade_db_diagnosis_aggressive \
    --stage2-baseline llm_agentic_openrouter_claude_sonnet_4_6
```

See [README §Quick Start](README.md#quick-start) for more examples.

## Paper

Companion paper subsection: `\subsection{Stage-2 diagnosis cascade}` in [hallmark-paper](https://github.com/rpatrik96/hallmark-paper) (PR #1, merged).
